en: Revenue rose 176% to $147.7M, well above the ~$117M consensus, helped by a one-off $31.6M SEG+ sale to a US defense customer, plus $8.1M of price-floor income from the Department of War. NdPr output rose 41% to 1,018 tonnes and sales 94% to 1,020 tonnes, giving the materials segment $47.8M of adjusted EBITDA. Adjusted EPS of $0.04 beat a −$0.01 estimate, though the GAAP loss was $0.12. MP gives no guidance; CEO James Litinsky called finishing GM magnet qualification an inflection point, with saleable deliveries and revenue starting in Q4.

The stock fell 6.0% to $33.74 on Nov 5 ahead of the report, a fourth straight loss and a 52-week low, as rare earth names sold off; it is down more than half from its May high. After hours it edged up about 0.5%, and on Nov 6 it closed up 4.9% at $35.41, as the surprise adjusted profit and the GM magnet go-ahead outweighed a one-off sale that flattered revenue and Q3 free cash flow of −$125M.
zh: 营收增长 176% 至 1.477 亿美元，远高于约 1.17 亿的市场预期，其中包括向一家美国国防客户一次性出售 SEG+ 所得 3,160 万美元，另有「战争部」价格保底收入 810 万美元。氧化镨钕产量增长 41% 至 1,018 吨，销量增长 94% 至 1,020 吨，材料业务经调整 EBITDA 达 4,780 万美元。经调整每股收益 0.04 美元，高于 −0.01 美元的预期，但 GAAP 每股亏损 0.12 美元。MP 不提供指引；CEO 詹姆斯·利廷斯基称完成通用汽车磁体认证是一个转折点，可销售磁体的交付及收入将于第四季开始。
财报发布前，股价 11 月 5 日下跌 6.0% 至 33.74 美元，为连续第四天下跌并创 52 周新低，稀土板块整体遭抛售；股价较 5 月高点已跌逾一半。盘后小幅上涨约 0.5%，11 月 6 日收涨 4.9% 至 35.41 美元：意外实现经调整盈利、通用汽车磁体获准供货，盖过了一次性销售推高营收以及第三季自由现金流 −1.25 亿美元的影响。

bio.en: Hedge-fund founder (JHL Capital Group) who led the group that bought the bankrupt Mountain Pass mine in 2017. Chairman and CEO since; took MP public in 2020 and struck the 2025 Department of War price-floor and magnet agreement.
bio.zh: 对冲基金 JHL Capital Group 创始人，2017 年牵头收购破产的芒廷帕斯稀土矿。此后任董事长兼 CEO，2020 年带领 MP 上市，并于 2025 年与「战争部」达成价格保底及磁体协议。

bio.en: CFO since 2019. Previously a managing director at JHL Capital, working on its MP investment, and earlier at Brahman Capital and King Street Capital in special-situations investing. Led the push into magnet making.
bio.zh: 2019 年起任 CFO。此前任 JHL Capital 董事总经理，负责 MP 投资，更早在 Brahman Capital 和 King Street Capital 从事特殊机会投资。主导公司进军磁体制造。

sources.t: Surprise adjusted profit and first-session move (Northern Miner)
